rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TNW159R

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TC7DXUJ

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass

* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TTF1JKT

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Shower Needs Updating - T5ZI98U

Resident said: Shower needs updating
Additional Details: Hello,

I am writing to request an accessibility modification for Ms. Ivy's bathroom due to significant safety concerns.

Ms. Ivy is 94 years old, and her current bathtub/shower setup has become increasingly difficult and unsafe for her to use. Stepping over the tub wall presents a serious fall risk, and she currently relies on a transfer bench for bathing. Because the bathroom is very small, the transfer bench makes it difficult to move around safely, creating additional hazards during transfers and increasing the risk of injury.

A walk-in shower would provide a much safer bathing environment by eliminating the need to step over the tub wall, which is one of the primary safety concerns. Walk-in showers are recommended when stepping over a tub wall is unsafe, when a client uses a shower chair or wheelchair, when there is a high fall risk during bathing, or when fear of falling causes someone to avoid bathing altogether. 

Given Ms. Ivy's advanced age and mobility limitations, an accessible bathroom would help her bathe safely, reduce her risk of falls, and allow her to maintain her independence. Without these modifications, she remains at increased risk for a serious injury that could result in hospitalization or loss of independence.

We respectfully request that the property consider replacing the existing tub with a walk-in shower or another ADA-accessible shower solution as a reasonable accessibility modification.

Thank you for your time and consideration. We appreciate your attention to this important safety issue and look forward to working together on a solution that will help Ms. Ivy remain safe in her home.

Sincerely,

Brandi Miller
EZ Health Guide

Doors

* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet

* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later

* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - T5E531W

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TQRKMUI

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Pots/pans or food left out

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet

* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TEXY83LB

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - T42YZ14

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - THGPK3Q

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

D - Maintenance - TW52QZF

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TYP8QZC

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TRVDKQT

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

D - Maintenance - TVZ8NUR

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - T8UDI1U

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Previous Maintenance Has Incomplete Job - TVB3EQB

Resident said: Previous maintenance has incomplete job
Additional Details: More prevalent at night but we still see them throughout the day. See full grown sized down to baby sized. The growth of number became prominent because there was a pipe bust that happened 6+ months ago that flooded our living room. Maintenance got it handled partially. They found out that our entire drymall was moist where our couch is located and they were supposed let it dry out and come replace it. It created mold in our drywall and that is when the cockroaches were starting to be noticed. And they grew exponentially. Bc we see them during the day means that we are infested but not sure where their nest is but we cleaned under our stove and there was no nest but we tried doing the same for fridge but there is something blocking us from pulling it out fully. I have noticed the more in the living room floor more than any other area in the house so it leads me to believe the nest is somewhere near the mold in the drywall I uploaded pictures from. Have seen them in the kitchen as well as climbing up and down the walls in living room

Troubleshooting Steps: 
- Reports moderate amount of pests
Permission to Enter: Yes

Entry Notes: Nothing worth extra awareness

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
Noise Complaint About Other Tenent - T2EKFIK

Resident said: Noise Complaint About Other Tenent
Additional Details: This is a complaint against the tenant in Apt #11 in my building. 

I'm having a problem with him constantly making thumping, bumping, banging noise. It started when he first moved in and there was a lot of power tool noise going on. I spoke to him about it and it turned out he was making a bed frame out of some old pallets. 

That ended shortly thereafter, but I kept hearing the stomping, banging noise along with loud verbal ranting. I spoke to him again about that and he admitted he had some kind of emotional problem and acted out like that. He said he would work on it and for the most part has kept that under control.

But I continue to hear the constant thumping, bumping, banging noise. It's random and happens any time of day or night. Last evening he was back at it with power tools and hammering. I knocked on his door, several times - once loudly - and he ignored me, continuing to hammer and bang on something. I gave up and left him alone.

I noticed him carrying a pallet out of the building, at night, a few days ago after another prolonged period of thumping/bumping/banging.

Sometimes in the morning I swear it sounds like he's rearranging his furniture every few days. Every now and then it sounds like he just drops a 20 pound weight on the floor. I was awoken around 3 AM this morning by such a loud "ka-thunk."

He's also running an old window mounted air conditioner that is making a constant humming, whining noise that I can hear in my apartment. I talked to him about that as well, and he stopped running it all day long for a bit, but now it's back to running for long periods when it gets hot out. It sometimes makes it difficult for me to fall asleep when he leaves it on later in the evening. It's directly above my bathroom window, but the sound also travels through the walls, just loud enough that it's difficult to ignore.

He left it running all night long last night.

I realize some people just aren't that conscientious of the noise they make, or just have "heavy feet," but this has really been getting on my nerves. I'm a solitary man and have my own mental health issues with anxiety.

Even as I write this he's up there doing whatever it is that requires this constant "thump-thump, bump-bump" noise. And he was once again using an electric screwdriver earlier.

I've been living here for 11 years. I don't think I should have to keep dealing with this persistent disturbance of the "quiet enjoyment" of my home.

Permission to Enter: Yes

Entry Notes: There's no need for that, but I'm home all day.

I realize some people just aren't that conscientious of the noise they make, or just have "heavy feet," but this has really been getting on my nerves. I'm a solitary man and have my own mental health issues with anxiety.

Even as I write this he's up there doing whatever it is that requires this constant "thump-thump, bump-bump" noise. And he was once again using an electric screwdriver earlier.

I've been living here for 11 years. I don't think I should have to keep dealing with this persistent disturbance of the "quiet enjoyment" of my home.

Permission to Enter: Yes

Entry Notes: There's no need for that, but I'm home all day.
